en.hubeali: Ahmad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Jareer Al Rawwasy who said,

‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> ask You<sup>azwj</sup> for the rest during the death, and Pardoning during the Reckoning’ – repeatedly’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ahmad has narrated from ibn Mahbub from abu Jarir al-Rawasiy who has said the following:
“I heard abu al-Hassan Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘O Lord, I pray to You to grant me comfort at the time of death and forgiveness at the time of issuing judgments repeatedly.”
